Added the operator summary up top: what changed on the replay path, what to watch during backfills, and where the deep detail lives.

Swept the flags: promoted the two permanent ones to defaults and deleted their flag checks; one experimental flag remains with an owner and an expiry.
The staging cluster still runs mixed binaries from the rollout waves. Roll it forward to the merged build so staging results stop depending on which node you land on.
Rolled staging forward to the merged build across all nodes and verified the version banner matches everywhere.
Also the rewrite changed the segment flush cadence assumptions; make sure the capacity model spreadsheet picked up the new write pattern.
Updated the capacity model with the post-rewrite write pattern and left the old columns hidden but intact for comparison.
The data team asked for a heads-up channel before large backfills run; set up the notification hook so their materialized views stop getting surprised.
Wired a backfill-start notification into the data team's channel with size and expected duration, and documented the hook in the rewrite doc.
Someone hit a confusing error when a backfill raced a retention sweep last week. Confirm the guard ordering and file whatever the fix is.
Confirmed the sweep now yields to staging backfills with the guard ordering fixed and filed; the confusing error message got rewritten too.
The rewrite retro wants concrete numbers; pull the before-and-after replay throughput from the burn windows into the retro doc.
Pulled both windows into the retro doc: replay throughput roughly tripled after the rewrite, with the caveat notes on measurement windows attached.
Last: the old row-assembly design doc should be marked superseded with a pointer forward, so searches stop landing people on the dead design.
Marked the old design doc superseded with a banner linking the rewrite doc, and fixed the three wiki pages that still linked the old one.
